domain-information: A Seller lists an item for auction to attract potential bidders.
A Seller updates the item description to provide clearer details for the auction.
A Bidder searches for active auctions to find items of interest.
A Bidder places a bid on an item to compete for ownership.
A Bidder increases their bid to stay ahead of other bidders.
An Auction Manager reviews a new listing.
An Auction Manager starts the auction at the scheduled time to open bidding.
An Auction Manager monitors bidding activity to ensure everything runs smoothly.
An Auction Manager declares the winning bidder once the auction ends.
A Shipping Officer orchestrates the delivery of the item to the winning bidder.
A Seller confirms shipment of the sold item to the shipping officer so it can be completed.
